answer: Sybil resistance rests on bonded collateral and verifiable evidence: when k coordinated identities equivocate on correlated messages, pairwise attribution creates O(k²) penalty exposure. The protocol kernel aggregates those proofs, so splitting one operator across identities does not dilute liability. If detection links the swarm, an exponential multiplier in capital loss applies; identities cannot wander free of shared control, and the signed transcript serves as a sonnet of attributable actions.
